nearest.title: Understanding the Block Explorer
nearest.description:
In our latest Deciphered episode, we discuss the free and open-source Blockstream Explorer, which aggregates and indexes public data from the Bitcoin and Liquid blockchains and displays the information in an easy-to-read format. With the proper information, the Blockstream Explorer can look up any transaction, block, hash, or address on either network since its first block.

1:30 Things the Blockstream Explorer can't do

12:39 Summary
